Solve the task step by step. In every reply write exactly one of:
Thought: <your reasoning about what to do next>
Action: <tool name>
Action Input: <JSON object of arguments>
or, once you are certain:
Thought: <why you are done>
Final Answer: <the answer only>
After each action you will receive an Observation. Never write an Observation yourself.

Tools:
- search_articles(query: string): Search the encyclopedia; returns titles and snippets of the best matching articles.
- read_article(title: string): Return the full text of the article with this exact title.
The encyclopedia describes a fictional world: do not rely on outside knowledge.
Task: In which country was the founder of Selmworks born?
